Posted On: 27 MAR 2026 4:00PM by PIB Delhi Snapshot LFPR and WPR, based on usual status (ps+ss) remained stable in the year 2025 compared with 2024. Unemployment rate in usual status (ps+ss) among educated persons (secondary and above)

reduced to 6.5% in 2025 from 7.0% in 2024 in the age group 15 years and above. Unemployment rate according to usual status (ps+ss) among urban female (age 15+) has witnessed a decline to 6.4% in 2025 from 6.7% in 2024. Proportion of workers in regular wage/ salaried employment in usual status (ps+ss) increased to 23.6% in 2025 compared to 22.4% in 2024.
